summary: Write SQL with connection-aware suggestions, reshape results without running the query again, and see more of what your server is doing.

changes.title: SQL IntelliSense
changes.text: Get suggestions for tables, columns and other database objects, inspect identifiers with hover, and see SQL issues in the editor. Refresh Local Cache updates the schema information when objects change.

changes.title: Filter results in place
changes.text: Use a column's funnel to choose values, search its value checklist, or filter by ranges, NULLs and duplicates. Filters combine with sorting. Search, copy, export, profiles and highlights follow the displayed rows; SQL is not executed again.

changes.title: Pivot and transpose
changes.text: Group displayed results and calculate counts, sums, averages, minimums or maximums in a new pivot result. Transpose turns displayed or selected rows into columns. Both outputs can be sorted, filtered, copied and exported.

changes.title: Activity Monitor Processes
changes.text: Inspect a live sessions grid with text and column filters, view chips, and switches for system sessions and Varia's own sessions. Expand more than one overview chart at a time.

changes.title: Recover a closed query
changes.text: Reopen closed queries as unsaved, disconnected copies. Create a query directly in an editor group, and see whether Execute will run your selection or the entire query. The status bar also offers Go to Line and insert/overtype switching.

changes.title: More ways to work with results and errors
changes.text: Copy a column's name, fit columns with the keyboard, close results from their toolbar, and jump from a SQL error to its source line when the source has not changed.

changes.title: Quicker updates on Windows
changes.text: An installed copy in a folder you can write now prepares a downloaded release while you work. Restart to Update swaps it into place. Installations for all users continue to use the installer. Restart verifies the downloaded file again before installing.

changes.title: Manual updates on macOS
changes.text: macOS builds tell you when a release is available and open its downloads page. They no longer download an update that this unsigned copy cannot install itself.

changes.title: Tabs, Peek and everyday navigation
changes.text: Tab focus, renaming and overflow are more reliable. Peek shows long definitions in a read-only editor with Find and SQL hover, and remains usable in narrow panels. Saved-connection selection and Object Explorer recovery actions are improved.

changes.title: Results remain consistent as you reshape them
changes.text: Corrected highlight and comparison edge cases, filtered row counts and reuse of filter/sort results. Numeric pivot sums retain precision up to 38 digits.

changes.title: IntelliSense uses its own connection
changes.text: Connected IntelliSense currently supports SQL Login and Windows authentication. Entra IntelliSense is not available yet; query execution keeps its existing authentication support. Query-session temporary tables and uncommitted changes are not visible to the analysis connection.

changes.title: Results stay in memory
changes.text: Transpose uses at most the first 4,095 displayed or selected rows and reports truncation. A pivot that exceeds its group or figure limits is refused with an explanation.

changes.title: More Activity Monitor panes are still to come
changes.text: This release adds the Processes grid. Blocking, Resource Waits, Data File I/O and expensive-query panes are not shown yet.

changes.title: Unsigned builds
changes.text: Builds remain unsigned, and macOS builds are not notarized. Your operating system may ask you to confirm that you trust the application.
